actions.add_task.description: Add a new task to a specified task list
actions.add_task.props.completed.descrip: Add the task already checked off.
actions.add_task.props.due.description: Google Tasks keeps the date only; the time is ignored.
actions.clear_completed_tasks.descriptio: Hide all completed tasks in a task list.
actions.complete_task.description: Mark an existing task as completed.
actions.complete_task.props.task_id.desc: The ID of the task to mark as completed. Obtain the id from Find Tasks.
actions.create_task.description: Create a new task in a task list, optionally as a subtask and/or positioned after a sibling.
actions.create_task.props.due_date.descr: Google Tasks keeps the date only; the time is ignored.
actions.create_task.props.parent_task_id: Make this a subtask of the task with this id (must be in the same list). Obtain the id from Find Tasks. Omit to create a top-level task.
actions.create_task.props.previous_task_: Place the new task immediately after the sibling with this id. Obtain the id from Find Tasks. Omit to place it first among its siblings.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_task.description: Permanently delete a task by ID.
actions.delete_task.props.task_id.descri: The ID of the task to delete. Obtain the id from Find Tasks.
actions.find_tasks.description: Search and list tasks in a task list with optional date-range and status filters.
actions.find_tasks.props.completed_max.d: Return tasks completed before this date (exclusive). RFC 3339 timestamp.
actions.find_tasks.props.completed_min.d: Return tasks completed on or after this date. RFC 3339 timestamp.
actions.find_tasks.props.due_max.descrip: Return tasks due before this date (exclusive). RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z.
actions.find_tasks.props.due_min.descrip: Return tasks due on or after this date. RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z.
actions.find_tasks.props.max_results.des: Maximum number of tasks to return (1–100). Defaults to 20 when omitted.
Include completed tasks in results. Defaults to true.
actions.find_tasks.props.show_hidden.des: Include hidden tasks (tasks that have been completed and a day has passed). Defaults to false.
actions.find_tasks.props.updated_min.des: Return tasks last modified on or after this date. Useful for "since last run" incremental reads. RFC 3339 timestamp.
actions.get_task.description: Fetch a single task by its ID.
actions.get_task.props.task_id.descripti: The ID of the task to fetch. Obtain the id from Find Tasks.
actions.list_task_lists.description: List the authenticated user's task lists (id and title).
actions.list_task_lists.props.max_result: Maximum number of task lists to return (1–100). Defaults to 20 when omitted.
actions.move_task.description: Reposition or reparent a task within its list, or move it to another list.
actions.move_task.props.destination_task: Move the task to this task list. Omit to keep it in the current list. Recurring tasks cannot be moved between lists.
actions.move_task.props.parent_task_id.d: Reparent the task under the task with this id (must be in the destination list). Obtain the id from Find Tasks. Omit to move it to the top level.
actions.move_task.props.previous_task_id: Place the task immediately after the sibling with this id (must be in the destination list). Obtain the id from Find Tasks. Omit to place it first among its siblings; to move it to the end, pass the last sibling's id (read the current order with Find Tasks).
actions.move_task.props.task_id.descript: The ID of the task to move. Obtain the id from Find Tasks.
actions.update_task.description: Edit an existing task — title, notes, due date, or status.
actions.update_task.props.due.descriptio: New due date for the task. RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. 2026-07-15T00:00:00Z.
actions.update_task.props.notes.descript: New notes / description for the task.
actions.update_task.props.status.descrip: Task status. To simply complete a task prefer Mark Task Complete; set needsAction here to reopen a completed task.
actions.update_task.props.task_id.descri: The ID of the task to update. Obtain the id from Find Tasks.
triggers.new_task.description: Triggers when a task is added to a list, or also when one is edited if you choose New and edited tasks.
triggers.new_task.props.info.description: With **New tasks only**, renaming, editing, moving or completing a task does not run the flow again; a task moved here from another list counts as new. With **New and edited tasks**, renaming or editing a task, or completing it through the API, runs the flow again, so the same task can arrive more than once; completing a task in the Google Tasks apps hides it and does not run the flow. Upgrading this piece to a new version in the builder pre-selects **New tasks only**; choose **New and edited tasks** to keep the old behaviour.
triggers.new_task.props.run_on.descripti: Whether edits run the flow again. Empty means "New and edited tasks".
